messages:
Priya: Heads-up: Sprintline onboarding saw an error spike overnight. Pulling numbers for the weekly health check. 5xx + gateway timeouts + a smaller 429 cluster.
Jamal: got it, paste the metrics?
Priya: Window 00:00-06:00 UTC:
- total error rate: 4.1% (usual ~0.5%)
- 5xx: 2.9% (502/503 predominately)
- gateway timeouts: 1.0%
- 429 rate-limits: 0.2%
Priya: Error distribution by endpoint (by count):
1) POST /v1/generate 1% of errors
2) POST /v1/embeddings 8%
3) POST /v1/chat/stream 2%
4) GET /v1/model/status 0%
5) POST /v1/session/kv-sync %
Priya: Quick trace excerpts:
```
[2026-03-20T03:11:58Z] req=aa11 route=/v1/generate status=502 upstream=runtime-io msg="connection reset by peer"
[2026-03-20T03:12:05Z] req=aa12 route=/v1/generate latency=4.2s gateway_timeout=true
[2026-03-20T03:13:30Z] req=bb22 route=/v1/embeddings status=429 key_qps=62
```
Elsa: Noted. Any recent prod changes? @infra-bot status of rollouts?
infra-bot: deploy-bot: prod rollout r-2026-03-20-0312 completed at 2026-03-20T03:12:07Z. Images: runtime-v2.4, batching-svc-v1.9. No rollback triggered.
Jamal: rollout timestamp aligns with spike. First step: separate genuine 502 upstream resets from batching timeouts. I'll pull connection error counters and rkvm cache evictions.
Tomas: Sprintline is still in onboarding ramp; this could be a renewal risk if it impacts demos. Priya, can you prep a CSM blurb?
Priya: Will do. Immediate mitigations I'm proposing:
- Route Sprintline POST /v1/generate to fallback runtime-v2.3 (canary -> full)
- Increase batching-svc internal timeout 3s->6s for the affected routes
- Edge throttle for high-concurrency API keys: cap at 40 qps for 2 hours
Elsa: I can flip 10% traffic to v2.3 as a canary now and enable detailed runtime logs for 30-60m.
Jamal: I'll stage a rollback plan: spin up extra runtime-v2.3 nodes and pin Sprintline if needed. Also checking for kernel EPIPE/OOM on runtime processes.
Priya: CSM message draft: "We're investigating elevated generation errors this morning due to a runtime rollout. Temporary fallback and throttles are in place; we'll update within 30 minutes." Tomas: approve.
infra-bot: alert-summary: 88% of 502s from three hosts in us-west-2 (i-0a1b2c3d, i-0a1b2c3e, i-0a1b2c3f). On-call: Jamal, Elsa.
Elsa: Host logs show repeated EPIPE in runtime-io and one host with high CPU + swap activity. Suspect a runtime-v2.4 quant kernel regression + workload shape change.
Jamal: Also noticing batch-size heuristics for Sprintline jumped (avg seq len +38%). That increases cache churn and latency, explains gateway timeouts.
Priya: Action items:
- Jamal: apply canary route -> v2.3 and scale fallback pool (ETA 15m)
- Elsa: enable verbose logs + validate kernel traces (ETA 20m)
- Priya: notify CSM and add note to weekly health doc (ETA 10m)
- Tomas: prep renewal-impact note if customer escalates (standby)
Elsa: Started canary routing (10% -> v2.3). Verbose logs on for nodes.
Jamal: Scaling v2.3 pool and pinning Sprintline keys to dedicated nodes where capacity allows.
Priya: I'll coordinate an enablement email to Sprintline engineers: recommend payload trimming, smaller batch sizes, and client-side retry/backoff adjustments.
Tomas: add finance note: if we move them to dedicated nodes, they may see billing delta; loop in finance.
Priya: Update in ~30m with verification metrics. If stable we'll keep canary then ramp.
infra-bot: action-log: remediation started by Jamal at 2026-03-20T03:19:09Z; canary applied (10% traffic -> runtime-v2.3).
